tools.description: Connection, what the table is drawing, progress (0-1), light and mode settings, and any latched table alarms (fatal alarms stay listed until the table reboots).
tools.name: get_status

tools.description: Pattern ids stored on the table, with names for ones drifted-host manages.
tools.name: list_patterns

tools.description: Digital twin, no table needed: check a drawing without sending it. Returns issues (errors block sending; 'fixed' were repaired) and stats (points, length, estimated seconds to draw).

points.description: Alternative to xy: [theta, rho] polar points, theta in radians, rho 0 (centre) to 1 (rim).

thr.description: Alternative: Sisyphus .thr text ("theta rho" per line).

xy.description: The path as [x, y] points in table radii: the table is the unit disc, centre (0,0), +x right, +y up. The ball never lifts, so the whole path is drawn, including moves between shapes.

tools.name: validate_pattern

tools.description: Digital twin, no table needed: shows the drawing before anything moves. Returns two images: the sand as it should look afterwards (grooves as wide as the ball, so lines closer than about 0.07 merge, as on the table) and a route diagram (green start, red end; every connecting move is drawn too). Always look at both before show_pattern, and iterate until it reads well.

thr.description: Alternative: Sisyphus .thr text ("theta rho" per line).

xy.description: The path as [x, y] points in table radii: the table is the unit disc, centre (0,0), +x right, +y up. The ball never lifts, so the whole path is drawn, including moves between shapes.

tools.name: preview_pattern

tools.description: Digital twin, no table needed: saves an animated GIF of the ball drawing it (a few seconds long), for showing the user before committing minutes of drawing time. Returns the file path and the real drawing time.

points.description: Alternative to xy: [theta, rho] polar points, theta in radians, rho 0 (centre) to 1 (rim).

tools.name: animate_pattern

tools.description: Draw something now. drifted-host validates, stores it in a managed slot (reusing one if it already holds the drawing) and starts it. clear='area' sweeps the sand under the drawing first so it reads cleanly (a few minutes); 'full' sweeps the whole table (~10 min).

tools.description: Store a drawing permanently under a name (for playlists). Most callers want show_pattern instead.

tools.name: save_pattern

tools.description: Delete a saved pattern by id.
tools.name: delete_pattern

tools.description: Play a stored pattern id, or pause/next/previous. With the playlist on, next plays the playlist's next pattern.
tools.name: playback

tools.description: Drifted's playlist keeps the table going: when a pattern finishes, Drifted starts the next stored one (shuffled unless shuffle=false). ids limits it to those pattern ids; an empty list means every stored pattern. show_pattern and live sessions put it on hold so the drawing stays on the sand; playback next or active=true carries on. Saved across restarts. Call with no arguments to read it.

ids.description: Pattern ids to play (see list_patterns); [] for all stored patterns

tools.name: playlist

tools.description: Lights and modes. color '#rrggbb' sets a fixed colour; brightness and speed are 0-1; shifting cycles the palette; random plays random stored patterns when idle; rotation (degrees counter-clockwise, saved) turns every drawing so pictures stand upright for the viewer.

rotation.description: Degrees counter-clockwise added to every drawing sent to the table, so up in your drawing is up for whoever looks at it. Saved by Drifted; get_status shows it.

tools.name: settings

tools.description: Start a live session: you then push short segments (each ideally 10-30 s of drawing) and the table draws them back to back. Exclusive until live_stop.
tools.name: live_start

tools.description: Queue a live segment. interrupt=true cuts in as soon as it's uploaded (about 1-2 s). Keep about two segments queued.

points.description: Alternative to xy: [theta, rho] polar points, theta in radians, rho 0 (centre) to 1 (rim).

thr.description: Alternative: Sisyphus .thr text ("theta rho" per line).

xy.description: The path as [x, y] points in table radii: the table is the unit disc, centre (0,0), +x right, +y up. The ball never lifts, so the whole path is drawn, including moves between shapes.

tools.name: live_push

tools.description: End the live session and restore random/loop settings.
tools.name: live_stop

tools.description: The table's on/off switch (the same one Apple Home uses). on=false stops the ball where it is; it stays stopped until turned on or a drawing is shown. Omit 'on' to read it.
tools.name: power

tools.description: The table's lamp switch, separate from power. on=true relights it at its last brightness; use settings for colour and brightness. Omit 'on' to read it.
tools.name: lamp

tools.description: connect or disconnect drifted-host from the table (disconnect lets the official app connect).
tools.name: connection
